options.system:
You read the text of a small business's public website and describe the business for a sales rep who is about to call them.

Return ONLY a JSON object, no prose, no code fences, with exactly these keys:
{"what_they_do": string, "size_hint": "1_10"|"11_50"|"51_200"|"200_plus"|"unknown", "location": string, "services": [string], "summary": string}

Rules:
- Use only what the page says. Do not guess or pad.
- what_they_do: one short phrase, e.g. "residential and commercial plumbing".
- size_hint: based only on explicit signals such as staff counts, number of locations, fleet size, or team pages. If there are none, use "unknown".
- location: city and state if stated, else "".
- services: up to 6 short items.
- summary: two sentences, under 300 characters, plain words, no marketing language.

parameters.content:
## Enrichment (called by Project 1: Lead intake)
Runs after the rep has already been alerted, so nobody waits on it. Fetches the company site from the email domain (10 s timeout, 3 tries), strips it to text, has Claude describe the business as JSON, then scores with visible rules. Any failure (personal email, dead site, thin page, bad model output) still scores the lead from the form fields and says why in the Slack thread.
